UP CM Yogi Adityanath Highlights Investment and Development

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has been actively promoting the state's investment potential and development initiatives. He discussed foreign direct investment (FDI), policy reforms, and a push for manufacturing, stating that Uttar Pradesh is "marching with global progress." Adityanath also urged students to read books and avoid overdependence on artificial intelligence. Separately, he commented on the Congress party, urging them to control "irresponsible childish antics."
